market_view: Calm bull regime with uncertain stability (0-day tenure, no confidence data). Macro data feed unavailable but NFP in ~10 days represents key catalyst risk. Environment favors quality momentum with defensive hedges. Extreme momentum names pose mean-reversion risk — sizing these conservatively while maintaining broad diversification across geographies and asset classes.
regime_assessment: Calm bull classification with zero documented stability. No historical realized returns from past calm_bull episodes (all pending). This is either a freshly entered regime or a classification lag. Treating as uncertain calm — maintaining equity exposure but with defensive hedges (UUP, KMLM, VNQ) and reduced concentration in extended names. NFP release sensitivity rated 4 — a hot print could trigger regime transition.

key_risks: Momentum reversal: 6 names above 200% 252d momentum. Even at reduced sizing (3-4% each), a coordinated reversal would hit ~20% of portfolio
NFP catalyst in ~10 days (sensitivity 4): Hot print could trigger hawkish Fed repricing, hurting rate-sensitive names (VNQ, HUM) and EM (EWY, EWT, EEM) simultaneously
Korean geopolitical risk: EWY + EWT = 12% Asia semiconductor/memory exposure vulnerable to US-China escalation
Commodity concentration: PDBC + DBB = 12% commodity exposure that would correlate near 1.0 in a demand shock
Infrastructure theme concentration: STRL + IFRA = 14% exposed to same CapEx/construction cycle
Data gaps: No SEC filing signals, no earnings cache, no macro data feed, no attribution history available. Operating with limited signal validation.
what_could_be_wrong: My biggest blind spot is the lack of macro data (yield curve, credit spreads, oil). I'm constructing a calm-bull portfolio without being able to verify the regime is actually calm. If credit spreads are widening or the yield curve is inverting, this portfolio is too risk-on. Additionally, my data quality overrides on WDC/VICR/STRL may be penalizing names where the quant is correctly identifying genuine AI-infrastructure alpha. The conviction gate approved all overrides, but with zero historical track record, I have no calibration on whether my judgment adds or subtracts value. I'm being conservative by construction, which could mean underperformance in a genuine momentum regime.
